text:
maya: Heads-up
I noticed our pagination + streaming examples diverge across the SDK pages. Python shows `stream=True` + resume token but TS and Go still only show single-shot fetch.

tom: oof, that's going to confuse users. which pages specifically?

maya: docs/guide/streaming.md and docs/reference/pagination.md. the streaming.md has an inline python example that got updated in last week's PR but the other pages weren't touched.

li: can you paste the python snippet?

maya: sure, current python snippet (abbreviated):
```python
resp = client.responses.create(model="rwd-4x", input=prompt, stream=True, resume_token=last_token)
for event in resp:
    if event.type == "delta":
        sys.stdout.write(event.delta)
```

akiko: resume_token there is a helpful hint. TS should show both stream and a resume pattern. otherwise folks will copy the non-streaming example and get stuck.

kevin: i'm happy to take TS. two style options: promise-based stream consumer or async iterator. i'd prefer async iterator for parity with other modern libs.

tom: agree on async iterator. also add a short note on idempotency: re-sending prompt vs resuming with KV header.

kevin: draft TS that I plan to PR:
```ts
const s = await client.responses.stream({ model: 'rwd-4x', input: prompt, resumeToken: lastToken });
for await (const evt of s) {
  if (evt.type === 'delta') process.stdout.write(evt.delta ?? '');
}
```
Add comment about `resumeToken` usage.

li: i'll own Go. Go currently has examples in three places; one of them calls List() with pages but doesn't show backoff. i'll add a simple exponential retry helper.

maya: can we also add a tiny smoke test that runs the three snippets in CI (mocked)? docs-ci can run it as part of the docs workflow.

docs-ci: We can run snippet smoke tests if they are placed under /examples/smoke/ with a short harness. I can gate on `docs:smoke` job.

kevin: ok i'll create examples/smoke/ts_streaming_smoke.ts which imports the SDK test client. keep it mocked to avoid network.

li: Go sketch (will push to branch):
```go
func fetchPages(ctx context.Context, client *sdk.Client) error {
  cursor := ""
  backoff := backoff.NewExponential(100*time.Millisecond, 2.0)
  for {
    res, err := client.Responses.List(ctx, sdk.ListOptions{Cursor: cursor})
    if err != nil {
      wait := backoff.Next()
      time.Sleep(wait)
      continue
    }
    for _, it := range res.Items {
      fmt.Println(it.Text)
    }
    if res.NextCursor == "" { break }
    cursor = res.NextCursor
  }
  return nil
}
```
I'll include note about respecting Retry-After header if present.

maya: excellent. one more: add a single-line cross-ref at the top of streaming.md to pagination.md and vice versa. small UX improvement.

kevin: timeline: i can open the TS PR in ~2h. will include smoke test and CI job change.

li: Go PR in ~3h.

maya: i'll open a tiny docs PR to add the cross-refs + mention of resume_token in the guidance language.

tom: let's make sure examples use the same param name: `resumeToken` in TS, `resume_token` in Python, `ResumeToken` in Go struct. note: keep naming idiomatic per language. mention mapping in a short table? maybe not necessary for this patch.

kevin: good call. i'll also add a short comment explaining the difference rather than a table. simpler for release.

docs-ci: automated check: PRs referencing examples/smoke/ will trigger docs:smoke. please add `ci: docs-smoke` label on PRs.

li: pushed branch `docs/go-stream-resume` and opened PR -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4398

kevin: opened TS PR -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4399 (includes smoke harness)

maya: opened cross-ref PR -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4400

tom: will review quickly after lunch. can we aim to have these merged before the scheduled docs release tomorrow morning?

maya: yes please. i will coordinate and keep this thread updated.

kevin: CI note: lint failed on my first commit due to triple-backtick fence in a markdown codeblock being indented. fixed in force-push.

li: review requested from @akiko and @maya on the Go PR.

maya: LGTM on cross-ref PR, left one nit about wording in the resume paragraph.

kevin: PR merged (4399). smoke job passed on the mocked harness.

li: PR merged (4398). added explicit handling example for `Retry-After` header.

maya: cross-ref PR merged (4400). thanks all. i'll let product know the docs are aligned. :tada:

docs-ci: Release reminder scheduled for 08:00 UTC tomorrow. docs:streaming + docs:pagination updated.

maya: closing thread, reopen if anything regresses.
